quotes.quote: Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime Arabic is a streaming speech-to-text model for Arabic dialects and Modern Standard Arabic.

This model is fine-tuned from Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602 and has approximately 4.4 billion parameters, with weights in BF16 precision. It processes 16 kHz audio through a causal audio encoder and language decoder, producing text as audio arrives.

The model is co-developed with the Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Réforme Administrative (MTNRA) under the umbrella of the strategic partnership signed between Mistral and Morocco in January 2026 as a sovereign AI asset.
At a configured transcription delay of 480 ms, the model achieves an average Character Error Rate (CER) of 8.82% across seven Arabic benchmarks.
It outperforms several open-source and proprietary offline models and comes within 0.91 percentage points of Voxtral Transcribe Arabic’s 7.91% CER.

We report Character Error Rate (CER) on established Arabic benchmarks and two new benchmarks, ISMA and Darija in the Wild, co-developed with Morocco’s Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Réforme Administrative (MTNRA). Lower CER is better.

All evaluations use temperature 0.0; the realtime model uses a configured transcription delay of 480 ms. CER is computed with normalization co-developed with MTNRA, covering Arabic dialect-specific spelling, clitics, loanwords, and spoken numbers.
The code is available in normalization.py. Scores may differ under other normalization methods.
Note: Gemini’s safety filters block transcription of some FLEURS audio samples.
Training focused on Arabic code-switching. We also observe improvements in code-switching involving languages outside the training focus.
The model targets Arabic transcription. For other languages, use the original Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime.
This model is licensed under the Apache 2.0 License.
Starting with transformers >= 5.2.0, Voxtral Realtime runs natively in Transformers.

Apply ``normalize_arabic_asr`` to both the reference and hypothesis before computing word error rate.
The rules remove diacritics and punctuation, normalize spelling and clitics, map selected lexical variants, and convert recognized spoken numbers to ASCII digits.
This is a fixed evaluation policy, not a general Arabic text normalizer. It always maps ذ to د and ث to ت, but preserves ظ versus ض.
Scores depend on these choices; use the same policy when comparing systems.

Built with a natively streaming architecture and a custom causal audio encoder - it allows configurable transcription delays (240ms to 2.4s), enabling users to balance latency and accuracy based on their needs.
A single text-token is worth 80ms.
We recommend using a delay of 480ms as we found it to be the sweet spot of performance and low latency.
